subject.title: Install ClawHub packages for new Claw agents

question: Should experimental `claws add` be allowed to mutate a process-wide plugin installation after an exact displayed-plan grant, or should shared plugins remain unavailable until a distinct host-level grant model exists?
rationale: The supplied discussion supports two plausible boundaries: explicit exact-plan consent for a shared runtime mutation, or deferring that mutation until a stronger host-level grant model is designed.

options.title: Accept explicit shared-host grants
options.body: Keep the displayed exact-plan consent design and require exact-head live proof of shared-plugin install, reuse, conflict rejection, and compensation before merge.

options.title: Defer shared-plugin mutation
options.body: Keep workspace skill installation but leave shared plugin package actions unavailable until maintainers approve a dedicated host-level grant model.

recommendation.title: Accept explicit shared-host grants
recommendation.body: Keep the displayed exact-plan consent design and require exact-head live proof of shared-plugin install, reuse, conflict rejection, and compensation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review comment directly frames the unresolved shared-host authority boundary.
